title: The 2-fibre product of two stacks in setoids over a stack in groupoids is a stack in setoids

standard_prerequisites.name: 2-fibre product of stacks in setoids
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the result whenever one leg is a faithful morphism from a stack in groupoids.

core_obligations: Observe that a 1-morphism from a stack in setoids to a stack in groupoids is automatically faithful: if F(alpha) = F(beta) then F(beta o alpha^{-1}) = id, and beta o alpha^{-1} lies in the trivial automorphism sheaf of the setoid stack.
Instantiate the cited lemma with the faithful leg f_2 and the symmetric role of the two legs of the 2-fibre product.
proof_roadmap: Deduce faithfulness of the setoid leg from trivial automorphism sheaves, then quote the 2-fibre-product lemma.
difficulty_reason: One observation (automatic faithfulness from trivial Aut) plus a direct instantiation of a named lemma.
